scenes.tts: Shine light on certain cells in a mouse's brain, and it freezes. Has the memory been found?
scenes.visual: Title fades. A mouse in a box; a blue light flashes on a small group of cells in a brain inset, and the mouse freezes. On screen: Has the memory been found?
scenes.narration: Shine light on certain cells in a mouse's brain, and it freezes. Has the memory been found?

scenes.tts: The cells were tagged while the mouse learned to fear a chamber.
scenes.visual: The mouse in a conditioning chamber. A small group of cells in the dentate gyrus inset turns green.
scenes.narration: The cells were tagged while the mouse learned to fear a chamber.

scenes.tts: A gene called c fos switches on in recently active neurons.
scenes.caption: A gene called c-fos switches on in recently active neurons.
scenes.visual: A neuron fires; inside it, a gene labelled c-fos switches on.
scenes.narration: A gene called c-fos switches on in recently active neurons.

scenes.tts: Its promoter can put a light-driven channel, channelrhodopsin two, into those cells.
scenes.caption: Its promoter can put a light-driven channel, channelrhodopsin-2, into those cells.
scenes.visual: The c-fos promoter drives a channel into the membrane of the active cells. Label: channelrhodopsin-2, light-driven, excites the cell.
scenes.narration: Its promoter can put a light-driven channel, channelrhodopsin-2, into those cells.

scenes.tts: A drug, doxycycline, blocks the tag. Take it away, and a window opens. Give it back, and the window closes.
scenes.visual: A gate graphic labelled doxycycline, closed. The gate swings open for a short window, cells active then turn green, then the gate closes again.
scenes.narration: A drug, doxycycline, blocks the tag. Take it away, and a window opens. Give it back, and the window closes.

scenes.tts: Open it around training, and mostly cells active during learning get the channel.
scenes.visual: The open window lines up with the learning session on a timeline; mostly those cells turn green, with a few scattered background cells. Label: some background labelling.
scenes.narration: Open it around training, and mostly cells active during learning get the channel.

scenes.tts: Days later, in a different box, light on the cells made the mice freeze.
scenes.visual: The mouse in a new box. Blue light on: the mouse freezes. Bars of time spent freezing, light off and light on; the light-on bar is tall. Name card: Liu and colleagues, 2012.
scenes.narration: Days later, in a different box, light on the cells made the mice freeze.

scenes.tts: Two controls made it specific. Cells tagged in a neutral box caused no fear freezing.
scenes.visual: A second mouse whose cells were tagged in a box with no shock. Light on: it keeps moving. Its light-on freezing bar stays low.
scenes.narration: Two controls made it specific. Cells tagged in a neutral box caused no fear freezing.

scenes.tts: Mice with a fluorescent protein but no channel did not freeze to light.
scenes.visual: A third mouse whose cells glow with a fluorescent protein but carry no channel. Light on: no freezing. Its bar stays low.
scenes.narration: Mice with a fluorescent protein but no channel did not freeze to light.

scenes.tts: So these cells are enough to drive the fear, in this preparation. That is sufficiency.
scenes.visual: The ladder returns: correlation lit, and on the upper rung the sufficiency test lights, beside an equal-height necessity test that stays dark. Label: enough, in this preparation.
scenes.narration: So these cells are enough to drive the fear, in this preparation. That is sufficiency.

scenes.tts: Does that mean the mouse needs these cells when it remembers by itself?
scenes.visual: The necessity test, side by side with sufficiency on the upper rung, unlit, with a question mark. On screen: Needed?
scenes.narration: Does that mean the mouse needs these cells when it remembers by itself?

scenes.tts: Not yet. Necessity needs the reverse: silence the tagged cells during natural recall, back in the shock box.
scenes.visual: The tagged cells switch from green to a dark, silenced colour. Label: inhibitory opsin.
scenes.narration: Not yet. Necessity needs the reverse: silence the tagged cells during natural recall, back in the shock box.

scenes.tts: Kitamura and colleagues tagged prefrontal cells at learning, then silenced them later.
scenes.visual: Name card: Kitamura and colleagues, 2017. The prefrontal cortex lights in a brain outline; cells there turn green at learning.
scenes.narration: Kitamura and colleagues tagged prefrontal cells at learning, then silenced them later.

scenes.tts: On day two, recall was intact. On day twelve, it was disrupted.
scenes.visual: Two pairs of freezing bars, light off and light on. Day 2: about equal. Day 12: light-on bar much lower. Corner label: schematic.
scenes.narration: On day two, recall was intact. On day twelve, it was disrupted.

scenes.tts: The standard model predicted that order. But these cells were tagged at learning.
scenes.visual: A timeline: learning (tag), day 2 not needed, day 12 needed. The learning tag mark glows.
scenes.narration: The standard model predicted that order. But these cells were tagged at learning.

scenes.tts: So the cortical part of the memory did not first appear after a later transfer. It formed at once, and matured.
scenes.visual: A caption reading cortical ensemble first appears much later is crossed out. The prefrontal cells, green from learning, grow denser spines over the timeline; the hippocampus stays in the picture beside them.
scenes.narration: So the cortical part of the memory did not first appear after a later transfer. It formed at once, and matured.

scenes.tts: So in these mice, a memory's group is not fixed in one place. Where it is depends on when you ask.
scenes.visual: Brain outline with the group spread between hippocampus and cortex; the prefrontal members brighten over time while the dentate cells dim, labelled dentate engram cells.
scenes.narration: So in these mice, a memory's group is not fixed in one place. Where it is depends on when you ask.

scenes.tts: That suggests why enough does not prove needed. If the group spans regions, driving one part can complete it.
scenes.visual: A brain map with several lit regions joined by links. Light on one region spreads to all of them.
scenes.narration: That suggests why enough does not prove needed. If the group spans regions, driving one part can complete it.

scenes.tts: Silencing one part may leave enough of the rest to complete it.
scenes.visual: One region goes dark; the remaining lit regions still complete the group. Label: an interpretation, from the model.
scenes.narration: Silencing one part may leave enough of the rest to complete it.

scenes.tts: All of this is mouse fear, over days to weeks. It is not yet human memory over years.
scenes.visual: Label under the ladder: mice, contextual fear, days to weeks.
scenes.narration: All of this is mouse fear, over days to weeks. It is not yet human memory over years.

scenes.tts: Enough does not prove needed. For each claim, ask which control it needs.
scenes.visual: End card. LINE: Sufficiency does not prove necessity. Ask which control each claim needs.
scenes.narration: Enough does not prove needed. For each claim, ask which control it needs.
